floor_source_subset: Actual StaticBody3D with one enabled BoxShape3D; translation-only transform inheritance, same world Y-up position frame, nominal box top and finite rectangle. Rotation, scale, constant surface velocity, missing provenance, crossed model or changed source refuses. Shape margin is retained, not added to nominal surface height or interpreted as contact.
floor_extent_rule: The measured torso's XZ projection plus an orientation-independent bound from the compiled torso half-diagonal, maximum hip offset, both leg links and foot radius must fit inside the finite floor rectangle. This is input applicability, not a behavioral acceptance threshold.
rule: Only the new V44 policy, and only when the unchanged V43 guard holds progression, selects the existing floor-upright support reference for all four limbs and sets reference knee-lift fractions to zero. Preserve each scheduled phase and nominal leg direction. Keep existing joint projection, floor/height feasibility arithmetic, reference slew, contact-selected reference rates, gains, damping and final motor limits. This requests support; it does not assert contact or static equilibrium. Apply the same current hold mode to both current-wave and prior-wave reference evaluations. Do not interpret a hold-mode switch as walking-wave feedforward. Store the original scheduled wave in reference memory. Record the effective no-lift reference and same-mode comparison waves separately. Keep actual observations, ordinary stance-latch choices, gait clocks, gate counters and guard lifecycle unchanged. A support-posture selection for a swing limb must not create a stance latch or a supporting-contact observation.
